page_title: ESP 1-1 OVI | Espanyol v Oviedo 09/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

88' That didn't go as planned! Jofre (Espanyol) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Aaron Escandell, who easily kept it out.
86' Pere Milla (Espanyol) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
86' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
82' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' Aaron Escandell makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) after a cross from the side. The referee blows his whistle, Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
79' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Tyrhys Dolan is replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
79' Today's match ends for Pol Lozano who will be replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
78' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
75' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
74' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola stops the game and makes a call.

73' Marko Dmitrovic was forced into action to thwart Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
72' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
72' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Alberto Reina will be replaced by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo).
71' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
69' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Pere Milla (Espanyol) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
68' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) replacing Ramon Terrats.
66' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Aaron Escandell is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
65' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Here is a change. Cyril Ngonge is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Pere Milla (Espanyol).
62' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
61' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
60' 12:8 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
57' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) makes a strong challenge and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Santiago Colombatto is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo).
56' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Luka Ilic and he is replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
56' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Ilyas Chaira replaces Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo).
54' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just wide of the left post.

54' A sweet pass finds Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Aaron Escandell is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
53' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
51' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
49' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Carlos Romero (Espanyol), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
43' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

41' What a wasted opportunity by Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Aaron Escandell makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
38' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
38' It looks like Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
36' 1 - 1 Kike Garcia (Espanyol) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
34' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
27' Javier Alberola couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) and blew his whistle.
27' Espanyol are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

25' Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
24' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
22' Rough tackle by Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola no option but to blow his whistle.
19' PENALTY APPEAL after Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
18' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
15' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
15' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

10' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
10' Espanyol take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' 0 - 1 Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) finds himself in a promising position after getting on the end of a pass and fires the ball inside the left post!
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Oviedo.
5' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
2' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Espanyol are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Oviedo will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
